description: This file implements a web interface for resetting and restoring a network gateway device, incorporating user confirmation dialogs, handling various reset/restoration actions via AJAX, and including related UI elements and scripts.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Handles the reset or restore action by sending an AJAX request, manages UI feedback, and handles the reboot or Wi-Fi restart process.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Polls the index.php page to determine if the device has rebooted, redirecting to login when ready.
